subject: Provo City Planning Commission Hearing Wed., June 9, 2021
comment: Dear Mr. Larsen, As per our phone conversation this morning about Items 3 & 4 on the the agenda for the Provo Planning Commission Hearing on Wednesday, June 9, 2021, I am expressing some concerns, as follows: 1) Increasing the population density by changing the zoning classification from Residential Conservation (RC) to Medium Density Residential (MDR) raises questions about the sustainability of existing infrastructure and services. Will this result in increasing the taxes on adjacent properties? 2) If this proposal is approved and goes forward, will this increase the need for police patrols and services. Especially concerning is the possibility that this will not become a hotbed of ethnic and indigent strife--much like one hears occurring in West Valley City. 3) In very large cities such as London, U.K., "large green space" is provided for the public to recreate, compete in sports, etc. I believe this may be in an effort to allow diversion from day to day stress. What "green space" is available to meet these needs if this proposal goes forward? 4) What will be the impact on schools if the changes occur? Thank you kindly for addressing these questions. I am sincerely grateful for your service to the residents and property owners in Provo City. Very truly yours, Kathleen & Paul Damron
